programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Leah invites her genies over to join the fun. Leah makes a wish to make Zac's house look haunted, but the genies turn it into a real haunted house, with a real Frankenstein! It's a spooktacular adventure!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Leah has invited Shimmer and Shine over for a sleepover party, where they'll eat pizza, dance all night, and sleep in a pillow fort! But when all the party plans go awry, the genies help Leah out with some wish granting.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Leah and Zac have been saving for months to get the big prize at the arcade. When the ticket counting machine malfunctions and ruins all of their tickets, Leah calls on her genies for some arcade assistance!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Leah and Zac are pumped for day of bowling! But Leah is having a tough time trying to knock down a single pin, so she calls on Shimmer and Shine to lend a little genie magic to improve her game.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Leah and Zac are practicing for the big skateboard competition when Leah's skateboard breaks. When Leah asks her favorite genies for a new board, Shimmer and Shine accidentally give her the wrong kind of board: a surfboard!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Leah wishes for more doll friends for her genies to play with in her new dollhouse, she didn't mean for the genies to shrink themselves down to doll-size! Another wish causes Leah to shrink by mistake too

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Leah accidentally lets a goat out of its pen at the petting zoo, she calls on Shimmer and Shine to help get him back. The girls and pets are led on a farmland adventure in pursuit of the escaped goat.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: It's time for Shimmer, Shine, and Leah to celebrate their Wishaversary! Shimmer and Shine made Leah the perfect gift: a bracelet with a magical touch. But Rocket gets a hold of Leah's bracelet and starts to float!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: The evil Sorceress Zeta steals Shimmer and Shine's new gem, transporting Leah and Zac into Zahramay Falls with it!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Shimmer and Shine fall for Zeta's bottle trap! Leah and the pets must figure out how to save them. It's the Zahramay Falls Magic Carpet Race! Shimmer, Shine, Leah, and Zeta all compete for the prized genie gem.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Leah and her genies are trapped in a cave, it's up to their friends Zac and Kaz to save the day. When the girls bake magical flying cookies, Zeta and Nazboo sneak into their palace to steal the flying flour.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Leah, Shimmer, and Shine meet a mermaid and explore her underwater world. Shimmer, Shine, and Leah explore an ice palace in their search for a magical gem.
programme.sub-title: Mermaid Mayhem/Snow Place We'd Rather Be

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Zeta steals Shimmer, Shine, and Leah's wishing star, and they must get it back before Zeta makes a wish. Zac wishes up a cool new carpet. But when Zeta gets her hands on it, the kids must find a way to get it back.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Zeta accidentally transports Tala the monkey to her lair, the girls set out to rescue her. The girls meet a real life ice genie! But when Zeta steals her ice gem necklace, it's up to the girls to stop her.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Zeta steals Samira's necklace, they must get it back before she figures out its special power./ When Zeta steals Samira's staff and turns everyone into chickens, Shimmer, Shine, and Leah must stop her.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam tries to cover up the truth when he loses Diane's priceless book.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: The guys of Cheers try to lift Carla's spirits when she places a personal ad.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.desc: Diane convinces Sam to go to Frasier with fake depression symptoms so that Frasier can analyze him and get his confidence back as a psychiatrist. But Frasier comes back with a diagnosis that Sam's depressed because he's still in love with Diane.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: South Park: Les Rouquins
programme.desc: Cartman fait un exposé raciste sur les roux. Pour lui donner une leçon, Stan, Kyle et Kenny le teignent en roux dans son sommeil. Mais Cartman s'adapte à la situation en créant une ligue qui clame la supériorité des roux.

programme.title: South Park: Piégé dans le placard
programme.desc: Stan est endoctriné par l'Église de Scientologie avant de découvrir qu'il ne s'agit que d'une vaste machination.

programme.title: South Park: Sauvez Wilzy-X
programme.desc: Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park: Le Retour de Chef
programme.desc: Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Danger Snobfog
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park: Un million de petites fibres
programme.desc: Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park: Homoursporc
programme.desc: Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir
programme.desc: Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.
programme.sub-title: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir

programme.title: South Park: La Maitresse de Ike
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Cartman d'être le surveillant des couloirs, il profite de l'autorité qui lui est confié pour faire régner l'ordre sévèrement. Pendant ce temps, Ike tombe amoureux de sa maîtresse et ils ont une relation ensemble.

programme.title: South Park: L'Enfer sur Terre
programme.desc: Satan organise une énorme fête pour petite gamine pourrie gâtée pendant que les enfants de South Park tentent d'invoquer le rappeur Biggie Small en prononçant trois fois son nom devant un miroir.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (1/2)
programme.desc: Éric ne supporte plus d'attendre la sortie de la Nintendo Wii et ne veut pas endurer trois semaines de patience supplémentaire. Il décide alors de se congeler pour se réveiller le jour de la sortie de la Wii.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (2/2)
programme.desc: Toujours 500 ans dans le futur, Cartman est mêlé à la guerre mais ils est plus préoccupé à trouver un moyen de jouer à la Wii. Cela étant impossible dans le futur, il cherche une façon de retourner à son époque.

programme.title: South Park: La Coupe Stanley
programme.desc: Stan entraîne l'équipe poussins de hockey et essaie d'en faire des gagnants.

programme.title: South Park: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy Marsh dit le mot « nègre » à la télévision nationale et devient la risée du pays ; Cartman se moque d'un nain et se bat contre lui.
programme.sub-title: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson

programme.title: South Park: La Photo
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire croire que Butters est gay, mais lorsque le père de ce dernier s'en aperçoit, il envoie Butters dans un camp de rééducation.

programme.title: South Park: Les Poux
programme.desc: Une infection de poux atteint l'école primaire de South Park. Alors que Madame Garrison refuse de donner des noms, Cartman trouve un moyen de savoir qui a des poux et ainsi de se moquer des enfants atteints.

programme.title: South Park: Chattomique
programme.desc: Un nouvel élève arrive a South Park : un jeune arabe. Cartman pense alors qu'un attentat se prépare. Grâce à Kyle, branché sur Internet, ils remontent la piste d'un attentat imminent sur Hillary Clinton en visite à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Le Fantastique Mystère de Pâques
programme.desc: Stan se demande pourquoi on doit peindre des œufs le jour de Pâques. Il ne s'attendait pas à découvrir un secret aussi énorme.

programme.title: South Park: G-Win!
programme.desc: Madame Garrison se fait plaquer pour la dernière fois. Elle compte bien passer toute sa colère sur sa classe de CM1.

programme.title: South Park: La Nuit des clochards-vivants
programme.desc: La ville doit faire face à une recrudescence des SDF. Les enfants vont essayer de régler ce problème épineux.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman prétend avoir le syndrome Gilles de la Tourette pour pouvoir dire des choses affreuses en direct à la télévision.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Caca
programme.desc: Randy est constipé. Il prend alors des laxatifs pour aller déféquer. Après quelques instants de terribles douleurs sur le trône, Randy s'apprête à tirer la chasse mais il remarque que son caca est démesurément grand.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 1
programme.desc: Eric assure avoir aperçu un leprechaun dans la forêt, mais Kyle ne le croit pas. Ils font un pari ensemble : si Cartman prouve l'existence du leprechaun, Kyle devra lui sucer les boules sinon il devra donner 10$ à Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 2
programme.desc: Les pires créatures ont été libérées par les terroristes et dévastent Imaginationland, où Butters est toujours piégé. Le gouvernement réquisitionne Stan et Kyle afin de trouver un moyen d'entrer à Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 3
programme.desc: Suite à l'accident du portail, Stan est entré dans Imaginationland où Butters est considéré par les créatures imaginaires comme un élu capable de sauver Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Zéro
programme.desc: Stan et Kyle sont accros au jeu Guitar Hero. Mais Stan est meilleur que Kyle, et leur amitié semble s'en dégrader.

programme.title: South Park: La Liste
programme.desc: Les filles ont une liste des garçons les plus beaux de la classe. Clyde est premier, mais à sa grande déception Kyle est dernier.

programme.title: South Park: Amygdales
programme.desc: Cartman se retrouve à devoir lutter pour sa vie lorsqu'une banale opération des amygdales tourne mal.

programme.title: South Park: Le Nouveau Look de Britney
programme.desc: Alors que les garçons aident Britney Spears à atteindre le pôle Nord, ils découvrent le secret qui se cache derrière sa popularité.

programme.title: South Park: Planète Gros Nibards
programme.desc: Dans cet hommage de South Park au film de 1981 « Métal Hurlant », les garçons découvrent que ce qui défonce réellement, c'est le pipi de chat.

programme.title: South Park: Canada en grève
programme.desc: Lassé d'être ridiculisé, le Canada se met en grève pour avoir plus d'argent et du respect. Cependant, personne ne prend cette grève au sérieux, excepté les enfants.

programme.title: South Park: Ciel, une quéquette !
programme.desc: Madame Garrison tente de trouver un moyen de redevenir l'homme qu'elle aurait toujours dû être. Cartman doit alors la remplacer et s'occuper de la classe.

programme.title: South Park: Y'a plus d'Internet
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park se réveillent et découvrent qu'ils n'ont plus Internet.

programme.title: South Park: Un épisode chez les cow-boys
programme.desc: Monsieur Garrison emmène ses élèves en voyage scolaire dans un village de pionniers reconstitué. Alors que Cartman passe la journée avec Butters dans son sillage, des malfaiteurs arrivent dans le parc.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy's hatred for humans is finally revealed!
programme.sub-title: A SHOCKING FACT! THE TRUE IDENTITY OF HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy's twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-Man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi's brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!
programme.sub-title: BACK TO ZERO! EARNEST WISHES FOR LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY'S ALL-OUT ATTACK! RED HAWK BLASTS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat…
programme.sub-title: COMING TO AN END! THE FINAL DECISIVE BATTLE AGAINST HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!
programme.sub-title: TO THE FUTURE! THE PATH TO THE SUN!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET REVEALED! THE TRUTH ABOUT THE ANCIENT WEAPON!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy's gang finally gets what's coming to them!
programme.sub-title: THE STRAW HATS STUNNED! THE NEW FLEET ADMIRAL OF THE NAVY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji stumble upon a couple of Big Mam's henchmen extorting sweets from the peaceful people of Fish-Man Island, the Straw Hats make a new – and very powerful – enemy!
programme.sub-title: SHE LOVES SWEETS! BIG MOM OF THE FOUR EMPERORS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats prepare to depart Fish-Man Island, a lion and a caribou come to blows over booby-trapped treasure, and Vice Admiral Smoker makes his presence felt in the New World!
programme.sub-title: MANY PROBLEMS LIE AHEAD! A TRAP AWAITING IN THE NEW WORLD!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew bid farewell to their new friends before setting off in search of the greatest adventures the New World has to offer!
programme.sub-title: FINALLY TIME TO GO! GOODBYE, FISHMAN ISLAND!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Usopp's extreme deep sea fishing adventure lands the crew in the middle of a deadly whirlpool, but an unexpected encounter with a pod of giant whales may bail the Straw Hats out of hot water!
programme.sub-title: TO THE NEW WORLD! HEADING FOR THE ULTIMATE SEA!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's arrival in the New World is marked by violent weather and the discovery of a tiny stowaway. When the Straw Hats agree to help their new friend, it could lead to big trouble with the Marines!
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami hatches a plan to save Lily's father, but the arrival of an ex-marine madman throws a monkey wrench into the rescue mission.
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro find themselves locked in battle with their latest foes, but Nami's knowledge of the sea may be the key to escaping this scrum alive!
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shuzo's squad of manned torpedoes targets the Straw Hats and the giants! The crazed captain tests Luffy's mettle in a showdown on land, but the wily pirate pulls off a supersized surprise in hopes to stomp out the madman for good

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast that could make short work of Luffy and the gang!
programme.sub-title: Arriving! A Burning Island – Punk Hazard!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro put their strength to the ultimate test in a battle with a dragon. Meanwhile, a band of mysterious intruders make their gassy presence felt aboard the Sunny!
programme.sub-title: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. the Giant Dragon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!
programme.sub-title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai’s Horrifying Severed Head!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes friends with a Centaur, Franky uses a cola-powered laser to break out of the clink, and Sanji takes a chance on a body-less Samurai!
programme.sub-title: Startling! The Secret of the Island Is Finally Revealed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami's soft spot for children prompts her to call off the escape and declare war on anyone who makes a kid cry. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang take a banana boat to the icy side of the island!
programme.sub-title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start to Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles the torso of a surly samurai, and Captain Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected!
programme.sub-title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook vs. the Mysterious Torso Samurai!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for the children, Luffy's group hopes to avoid a perilous plunge into icy waters, and Captain Smoker faces off against Trafalgar Law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami's group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!
programme.sub-title: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-Cold Lake!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy and his mates race toward a reunion, Admiral Smoker struggles to survive a heart-stopping showdown with Trafalgar Law!
programme.sub-title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew – and the loss of his extra legs – quickly dampens the captain's enthusiasm!
programme.sub-title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard's mysterious transformation!
programme.sub-title: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Toriko, Luffy, and Goku's three-way tie in the World's Best Eating Competition, the festivities are interrupted by the sudden appearance of a monster that threatens to consume every living thing on earth.
programme.sub-title: History’s Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!
programme.sub-title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky – still trapped in Chopper's Body – makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!
programme.sub-title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!
programme.sub-title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!
programme.sub-title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob – and the evil genius who created the monster!
programme.sub-title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats make a valiant push to capture Caesar Clown - Luffy matches his Armament Haki with Clown's powerful Gas-Gas Fruit powers! The battle turns in favor of the Straw Hats, but underestimating Clown's abilities may have deadly consequences!
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves and fairies from the forest!
programme.sub-title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Big Birthday Adventure: Happy Birthday, Dora! In the final episode of the Magic Storybook Trilogy (and a nod to The Wizard of Oz) Dora and Boots need to get home for Dora's birthday party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom: Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A Greedy King has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Mermaids: It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid. Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's World Adventure: All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day! But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Lost and Found: Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Hic-Boom-Ohhh: What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate. They'll have to go across the Noisy River, then tiptoe through the Quiet Forest, and that's how they'll get to Yellow Valley to find the sound.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Ice Cream: Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Choo Choo: All aboard! It's time for the big train race. First train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Treasure Island: Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Three L'il Piggies: Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Big River: Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Berry Hunt: Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful--Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: WizzleWishes: Dora and Boots meet Wizzle who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Grandma's House: Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Surprise: It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Sticky Tape: Benny the Bull needs some Sticky Tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking, and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bouncing Ball: Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack: Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the Library. Can they reach the Library before it closes?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bugga Bugga: Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water: Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Star: Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Prince: Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken: Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off on an educational adventure to meet him.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.sub-title: Arthur and The Real Mr. Ratburn/Arthur's Spelling Trubble

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Reads are having a wonderful time at the beach, except for D.W. who simply refuses to have fun. Next, Buster and Arthur make a long-awaited field trip to a dinosaur excavation.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Someone only D.W. can see has moved in with the Reads. Her name is Nadine, and she follows D.W. everywhere. Arthur is the first to get the new Scare-Your-Pants-Off book from the library. Unfortunately, he can't figure out where he put it!
programme.sub-title: D.W.'S Imaginary Friend/Arthur's Lost Library Book

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: How can Arthur prove to his parents that he's responsible enough to take care of his very own puppy? "Get a job," suggests D.W.!. Yet another personality change for D.W., who's decided that from now on, she'll be just like Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and Francine are fighting. But when they get locked inside the library they either have to make up or prepare for a long evening. And when Buster opens his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and his friends go to summer camp where it's strictly boys vs. girls. Next, Buster Baxter is everyone's favorite jokester. Unfortunately, though, Buster's grades aren't as good as his jokes, and Buster may have to repeat third grade.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Goes To Camp/Buster Makes The Grade

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's new puppy is exactly what he wanted. He's cute and wriggly, and he follows Arthur everywhere. But training a puppy is harder than Arthur thought. Then, a mere $10 stands between Arthur and the shoes he's been dreaming about.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Only four more days until Arthur's birthday party! But to Arthur's horror, it turns out Muffy's having her birthday party on the very same day. And, now that Francine finally has the lead in a school play, she's has become a stage tyrant.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Writes A Story/Arthur's Lost Dog

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s beloved bird gets very sick, and despite D.W.'s eager ministrations, Spanky dies. Can she risk giving her heart to another pet? Then, Buster doesn't have time for Arthur. And all he wants to talk about is a new friend named Mike.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.
programme.sub-title: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Family Vacation/Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.
programme.sub-title: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy bets Francine she can't be nice to everyone for a whole week--and soon wishes she hadn't. Next, Arthur didn't mean to tell a lie, he just got stuck in a sort of fib, because he thought it was cool to be a Gleeper.
programme.sub-title: Meek For A Week/Arthur, World's Greatest Gleeper

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The circus is in town and the whole family's excited—until Arthur gets CHICKEN POX! Will he recover in time? Then, Arthur's worst fears come true when poor, sick Pal has to sleep overnight at the vet's office. Could it be something he did?
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Chicken Pox/Sick As A Dog

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: In D.W.’s heart lurks one big, gnawing desire--TO GET RID OF THOSE TRAINING WHEELS! Then, can Coach Frensky work with a baseball team where everyone is fighting about who gets to be pitcher and no one wants to practice?
programme.sub-title: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's raining and boy is it BORING! But then, in Grandma Thora's attic, Arthur and D.W. discover some really FASCINATING stuff about their parents. Next, Grandma Thora is helping to organize a bake sale, but her goodies aren’t very good.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Almost Boring Day/The Half-Baked Sale

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A new girl has arrived in town and no one knows anything about her. And judging by the strange things happening at her house no one wants to know. Then, it's great having a friend spend the weekend.
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Moves In/The Perfect Brother

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. saves everything. But her most prized possession is a snowball from last winter. But now it’s disappeared! Then, Arthur, Francine, and Buster must do a report on ancient Rome--but can they work as a team to complete the assignment?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is Binky Barnes really the most disgusting, nasty, horrible person on the planet, or is he just misunderstood? Next, what's got four sides and the answer to everything? Prunella's cootie catcher!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Once again, Arthur gets to do everything. Mostly he gets to carry the ring in Aunt Lucy's wedding. Elwood City's park is in sad shape, and after grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteered to clean it up.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mr. Ratburn's class is taking a field trips to visit parents at their jobs. Francine's not sure she wants the class to know her dad is a garbage man. And a new carpet and a sneezing attack means Muffy must spend the weekend at Francine's.
programme.sub-title: My Dad, The Garbage Man/Poor Muffy

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. has one little secret--her blankie. When it mysteriously disappears, Arthur is pressed into service. Find that blankie--or else! Next, the unbelievable has happened--Mr. Ratburn has gotten sick. And who's going to be the substitute?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Challenged by Fern to enter a poetry contest, Arthur and his friends each write a poem to be judged by the famous poet Jack Prelutsky. Then, Arthur and his friends develop a consuming passion for the Scare-Your-Pants-Off books.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The gang can't agree on rules for their club, and each starts his own. Next, Francine's embarrassed by her crummy old bike. Why can't she have a shiny new one like all her friends?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Have you ever been afraid of the dark? Despite D.W.'s threat of aliens, Arthur sets his tent for his first sleepover. Then, what exactly happens at midnight, December 31st? There are plenty of rumors, but no one seems to know for sure.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's First Sleepover/Arthur's New Year's Eve

programme.title: Arthur and the Haunted Tree House
programme.desc: While trick-or-treating, Francine meets an old woman with a very mysterious past, while Binky finds himself at Mr. Ratburn’s amazing haunted house! Then, can Arthur, Buster, and Ladonna figure out what’s haunting their tree house sleepover?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mister Rogers is staying at Arthur's house! Mister Rogers is a nice guy, but... his show is for babies! Can Arthur hide the visit from his friends? Next, the trouble starts when Fern draws a not-too-flattering cartoon of Francine.
